concept: Review and integration: what it feels like to know your actions matter so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of your choices changing outcomes, starting things yourself, and finding what you can do about problems — which feels most true for you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'agency' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
